selection: SEC large accelerated filers with a 10-K filed in the last 15 months and a ticker on NYSE or Nasdaq

revenue.rule: In the chain order, except that a larger total Revenues in the same filing beats contract revenue alone

sga.rule: SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense; else SellingAndMarketingExpense or SellingExpense, plus GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense, from the same filing

cash_sti.rule: CashCashEquivalentsAndShortTermInvestments; else CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue plus ShortTermInvestments, MarketableSecuritiesCurrent or AvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebtSecuritiesCurrent (cash only when none is tagged), from the same filing

liabilities.rule: Liabilities; else LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity minus total equity (including noncontrolling interest) and temporary equity, from the same filing

total_debt.rule: DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount; else LongTermDebt plus ShortTermBorrowings or CommercialPaper; else LongTermDebtNoncurrent or LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations plus DebtCurrent, or plus LongTermDebtCurrent and ShortTermBorrowings or CommercialPaper; an untagged current part counts as zero; all parts from one filing
